It does not grade or verify any manufacturer accuracy claim. Claims are recorded exactly as the listing states them.

new_irregularities_for_review.finding: Every one of the five 'customers who viewed this item also viewed' carousels contains a near-title-clone of the tracked product at a different ASIN: P1 has B0B7C327LK ('Chefman 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer - Digital Touchscreen, Smart Sync Finish…'), P2 has B0BZ52FLKC (Emeril 25QT Dual Zone), P3 has B0CNY1YVDD (Chefman 6 QT), P4 has B0GL7Z4KP4 and B0DNMTK56N (ThermoMaven variants), P5 has B0FXBQ3KX1 (CHEF iQ Sense, 2 probes).
new_irregularities_for_review.why_it_matters: Two risks, both buyer-facing. (1) Attribution: a '$' figure rendered next to a clone is trivially mistaken for the tracked product's price. This is the mechanism behind F-17 and it is now observed on all five pages, not three. (2) Destination: a reader who searches the product name can land on the clone instead of the tracked ASIN, which earns nothing and may be a different unit. The site's own links are all direct /dp/ links for this reason.
new_irregularities_for_review.evidence: The five listing pages above; see price_trap_observed on each entry.
new_irregularities_for_review.action_for_owner: Nothing on the site to change. Worth keeping the direct-ASIN policy (F-P17 lineage) and worth knowing that a search-arriving reader may compare this site's figures against a sibling model's listing and conclude the site is wrong.

new_irregularities_for_review.finding: P4's listing page rendered a full buy-box block ('$16.99', 'In Stock', a delivery date) while P1, P2, P3 and P5 rendered only carousel and protection-plan figures in the same fetch.
new_irregularities_for_review.why_it_matters: It shows the fetches are not uniform: Amazon varies the page it serves. It is also the clearest demonstration yet that a price read this way would sometimes exist and sometimes not — which is exactly why a published price column is unsafe (the open question behind D-P11 / Q-27) and why this pass records no price at all rather than a partial column.
